The continue-cursor is strictly better than the reset on both axes checked: math_owm exposure goes 3/2/1 -> 2/2/1 (same mean 1.8835, less skew); sub-1-epoch domains (zh_web 0.08, en_c4 0.66, code 0.74) get fresh rows instead of repeating stage 1's prefix. target: step3500 readout contest: per-role domain loss scored on ladder heads (zero domain overlap), b0 ruling (a) stand-with-confound vs (b) rescore
verdict: floor on any head -- neither reading stands as reported
finding: Prereg §2 "对阶梯点同头比较" licenses ladder-heads procedurally, but its threshold logic assumes both checkpoints in-distribution on the scored text. (b) rescore is the stage-1 own-mix baseline the 30B readout needs, but pairing it against p324 is the mirror confound.
notes: Verdict: 地板 by construction for zero-overlap pairings; prereg amended with section 7 scope condition. ceval +0.4pt floor stands; generative absent by design per §3.1; 3.211B actual accounted (step rounding 14.7M + cap 13.2M = 27.9M ≈ observed 28.7M).
